subject: RE: your story
body: Thank you for reaching out. If you're willing, I'd love to hear how the layoff happened and how you're coping. No pressure, and nothing goes to print without your okay.

outcomes.when: the player shares their story honestly and sincerely
outcomes.reply: Thank you. Really. This is exactly the human side people need to see.

outcomes.when: the player gives a short, guarded, or generic answer

hints: Take your time. Whatever you're comfortable sharing helps, even a little. Nothing runs without your okay.
